title: Lab Rats Portal Escape
description: Three anthropomorphic white mice in purple and black hoodies stand in a futuristic purple laboratory. A large circular green portal glows on the wall while a broken metallic pod emits green light and white smoke from the floor, surrounded by game controllers and papers.
prompt: Anthropomorphic white lab mice wearing purple and black hoodies stand inside a purple futuristic laboratory. One mouse points toward an arched window showing a moonlit landscape while another holds a small device. A large circular green glowing portal is embedded in the wall. A broken metallic pod lies on the floor emitting bright green light, smoke, and sparks. Pink and purple game controllers and schematic papers are scattered on the ground. Pixelated particles float in the air. Cartoon style with vibrant colors and clean lines.
